title: History: the disaggregation of the value chain (IDM to fabless/foundry/OSAT/IP), 1980-2025
why_it_matters: The split into fabless, foundry, OSAT, EDA and IP specialists is the single biggest structural change in who captures value; this pass found dated milestones but no quantified share series.
questions: How did the revenue share of fabless firms, foundries and IDMs evolve from 1990 to 2025?
When and why did assembly/test (OSAT) move offshore and become independent?
Which IDMs went fab-lite or fabless, when and why?
primary_sources: Company 10-K/20-F filings (TSMC, UMC, AMD, Qualcomm, Nvidia, ASE)
secondary_sources: academic histories of the foundry model

title: History: memory cycles and memory-maker consolidation (1970-2025)
why_it_matters: Memory has repeatedly caused industry-wide crises (1985, 2001, 2008, 2012 Elpida, 2023) and consolidated to a few firms; understanding the cycle is essential to any capacity or pricing judgement.
questions: What is the DRAM and NAND revenue/price time series by year?
How did the number of DRAM makers fall over time, and via which bankruptcies/mergers?
What role did HBM and AI play in the 2024-2025 upswing?

title: Policy: evolution of semiconductor export controls 2018-2026 (US, Netherlands, Japan, China countermeasures)
why_it_matters: Export controls now shape who can sell equipment and advanced chips to whom; the regime changed repeatedly after 2019 and includes Chinese countermeasures.
questions: What did each US BIS rule (2019 Huawei, Oct 2022, Oct 2023, Dec 2024, 2025-26 changes) control?
What did the Netherlands and Japan add, and when?
What countermeasures did China adopt (e.g. critical mineral export controls)?

title: Policy: comparison of chip industrial policies (US CHIPS, EU Chips Act, Japan, Korea, China, Taiwan, India)
why_it_matters: The post-2020 policy turn directs hundreds of billions in subsidies; results and disbursement differ widely from announced totals.
questions: What was appropriated vs actually disbursed in each regime?
Which fabs were funded and what is their status?
How did US policy change in 2025 (equity stakes, Section 232)?
primary_sources: European Commission / European Court of Auditors

title: History: Japan's rise and decline in semiconductors (1970s-2010s)
why_it_matters: Japan's rise triggered the first trade war and industrial-policy response; its decline shows how leadership shifts. This pass lacked primary share data.
questions: What were Japan's shares of the total market by year and product?
What were the VLSI Project and later consolidation (Elpida, Renesas, Kioxia) and why did share fall?

title: Dynamics: the AI demand shift - accelerators, HBM and advanced packaging (2022-2026)
why_it_matters: AI data-center demand has become the dominant growth driver and shifted value toward GPU/accelerator designers, leading-edge foundry, HBM memory and advanced packaging.
questions: How large is AI-related semiconductor revenue and which segments capture it?
What bottlenecks (CoWoS packaging, HBM) emerged and who controls them?
How does this compare historically with PC and smartphone demand waves?
primary_sources: Nvidia/AMD/Broadcom/TSMC/SK hynix/Micron filings and earnings transcripts
